ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for the sequencer and synchronizer processes, driving capture of sreg_ext, sreg_sys and the three registered outputs on clock edges.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in both sequencer and synchronizer processes; clk_i in their sensitivity lists.

ports.name: rstn_ext_i
ports.functionality: Acts as an active-low asynchronous reset; when '0' it clears sreg_ext and sreg_sys and forces all output reset ports low, overriding normal clocked updates.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_ext_i = '0') then ... branches in both sequencer and synchronizer processes assign zeros to registers and outputs.

ports.name: rstn_wdt_i
ports.functionality: When low it forces sreg_sys cleared (gating the system reset path); it is also forwarded synchronously to xrstn_wdt_o on clock edges.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_wdt_i = '0') or (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then sreg_sys <= (others => '0'); and xrstn_wdt_o <= rstn_wdt_i in synchronizer on rising_edge(clk_i).

ports.name: rstn_dbg_i
ports.functionality: When low it forces sreg_sys cleared (gating the system reset path); it is also forwarded synchronously to xrstn_ocd_o on clock edges.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_wdt_i = '0') or (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then sreg_sys <= (others => '0'); and xrstn_ocd_o <= rstn_dbg_i in synchronizer on rising_edge(clk_i).

ports.name: rstn_ext_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external reset output derived from the and-reduction of sreg_ext; is forced low during the asynchronous external reset branch and otherwise reflects sreg_ext state.
ports.evidence: rstn_ext_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_ext) in rising_edge branch; rstn_ext_o <= '0' in the rstn_ext_i = '0' reset branch of sequencer.

ports.name: rstn_sys_o
ports.functionality: Drives the system reset output derived from the and-reduction of sreg_sys; is forced low by asynchronous external reset and otherwise reflects sreg_sys progression.
ports.evidence: rstn_sys_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_sys) in sequencer rising_edge branch; reset branch sets rstn_sys_o <= '0'.

ports.name: xrstn_wdt_o
ports.functionality: Captured synchronously on clk_i from rstn_wdt_i and forced to '0' by external reset; forwards the synchronized watchdog reset to the entity output.
ports.evidence: in synchronizer process xrstn_wdt_o <= rstn_wdt_i on rising_edge(clk_i); reset branch sets xrstn_wdt_o <= '0'.

ports.name: xrstn_ocd_o
ports.functionality: Captured synchronously on clk_i from rstn_dbg_i and forced to '0' by external reset; forwards the synchronized debug reset to the entity output.
ports.evidence: in synchronizer process xrstn_ocd_o <= rstn_dbg_i on rising_edge(clk_i); reset branch sets xrstn_ocd_o <= '0'.

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising edge that sequences the ticker process; it times updates of en, cnt and cnt2 so the counter increments and outputs are generated on clock edges.
ports.evidence: ticker process has rising_edge(clk_i) and assigns en, cnt and cnt2 inside that branch

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides an asynchronous reset that forces en, cnt and cnt2 to their reset values when '0', overriding their normal clocked updates; it also appears in the process sensitivity list.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in ticker process sensitivity list assigns en, cnt, cnt2 to zeros

ports.name: enable_i
ports.functionality: Provides a vector whose OR-reduction is sampled into en; the port's bits are reduced by or_reduce_f and that result is captured into en to enable counting.
ports.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i) inside the rising_edge branch of ticker process

ports.name: clk_en_o
ports.functionality: Exports eight single-bit clock-enable pulses derived from counter bits; each clk_en_o(bit) is assigned cnt(i) and (not cnt2(i)) to produce a one-cycle pulse at various divide ratios.
role: carries divided clock pulses to consumers
ports.evidence: concurrent assignments like clk_en_o(clk_div2_c) <= cnt(0) and (not cnt2(0)); similar lines for other divisors

signals.name: sreg_sys
signals.functionality: 4-bit shift register that shifts in '1' each clock when not held by watchdog/debug and is cleared by external reset or by rstn_wdt_i/rstn_dbg_i; supplies rstn_sys_o via an and-reduction.
signals.evidence: sreg_sys <= (others => '0') or sreg_sys(sreg_sys'left-1 downto 0) & '1'; rstn_sys_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_sys) in sequencer process.

signals.name: sreg_ext
signals.functionality: 4-bit shift register that shifts in '1' each clock when not held by external reset and is cleared by asynchronous external reset; supplies rstn_ext_o via an and-reduction.
signals.evidence: sreg_ext <= (others => '0') in reset branch or sreg_ext(sreg_ext'left-1 downto 0) & '1' on rising_edge; rstn_ext_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_ext).

signals.name: en
signals.functionality: Captured on clk_i as the OR-reduction of enable_i; it holds whether counting is enabled and its value gates whether cnt increments each clock.
signals.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i) on rising_edge(clk_i); if (en = '1') then cnt <= unsigned(cnt)+1 else cnt <= (others=>'0')

signals.name: cnt
signals.functionality: Holds a 12-bit counter incremented each clock when en = '1' by using its prior value; it supplies bits to clk_en_o and is copied to cnt2 every cycle.
signals.evidence: cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cnt) + 1) when en='1' and cnt2 <= cnt copies cnt; cnt(i) used in clk_en_o assignments

signals.name: cnt2
signals.functionality: Captured each clock as a copy of cnt to provide the previous-cycle counter value; its bits are used with cnt bits to detect rising transitions and form single-cycle pulses.
role: supplies delayed bits for pulse detection
signals.evidence: cnt2 <= cnt in rising_edge branch; cnt2(i) used in clk_en_o(...) assignments as (not cnt2(i))
